text: The Budget Subcommittee for Scarborough Civic Centre and North York Civic Centre Consultations will hear public presentations on the 2020 Capital and Operating Budgets at Scarborough Civic Centre on January 20, 2020 from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m.. At its meeting on December 6, 2019, the Budget Committee established two subcommittees to hear the public presentations on the 2020 Capital and Operating Budgets at Scarborough Civic Centre, North York Civic Centre, Etobicoke Civic Centre and City Hall, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: 2020 Budget Public Presentation Meetings Name of Subcommittee Members Meeting Dates, Locations and Times Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and Etobicoke Civic Centre Consultations Councillor Gary Crawford (Chair) Councillor Mike Layton Councillor Frances Nunziata January 20, 2020 City Hall 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards January…
The Budget Subcommittee for Scarborough and North York Civic Centre Consultations received for information the public presentations and the communications submitted by members of the public.
